purpose: Primary literature for the actual D12 Eisenstein/Sym2 cocycle stabilizer problem; independent of affine_galois manifests
archive_policy: Original fixed-version PDFs downloaded without rewriting; SHA256/page count/header and first-page title/author/version visually verified

entries.title: Higher Weight Generalized Dedekind Sums
entries.first_page_visual_verification: Title, author, arXiv v1 identifier and 19 Dec 2025 date confirmed on rendered original page
entries.actual_read_scope: PDF pp. 1-5: definitions, finite-sum theorem 1.7, quantum-modular and lattice statements, Fricke setup; PDF pp. 22-23: section 6.2 proof of theorem 1.17, slash-stable lattice, finite-generator interpolation and containment/equality distinction. This is a targeted reading, not a claim that all 29 pages have been reviewed.
entries.usable_input: Higher-weight polynomial-valued period integral; B1 times B_(k-1) finite formula; all-group arithmetic containment follows from finite-generator period polynomials and slash-stable lattices.
entries.application_limits: Characters in the stated construction are both primitive and nontrivial. Our D12 source contains ordinary old E4 and character-times-trivial Eisenstein terms with regularized cusp constants, so the source-level statements do not directly apply. Theorem 1.17 gives image containment, not full kernel classification; numerical image conjectures remain conjectures.

entries.title: The kernel of newform Dedekind sums
entries.published_reference: Journal of Number Theory 223 (2021), 53-63; the archived file is the 9-page arXiv v1 preprint
entries.first_page_visual_verification: Title, three authors, arXiv v1 identifier and 13 Aug 2020 date confirmed on rendered original page
entries.actual_read_scope: PDF pp. 1-8: weight 2/scalar crossed homomorphism setup, finite B1-B1 sum, Fricke reciprocity, kernel theorems 1.9-1.11, propositions 2.1-2.5/corollary 2.7 and their proofs, index/commutator arguments, Galois kernel invariance. References/address page 9 was not needed for the mathematical review.
entries.usable_input: Structural use of reciprocity and unipotent powers to obtain infinite kernel families; separating strong nontriviality, infinite index and full kernel classification; algebraic Galois invariance applies only to the Dedekind-sum values.
entries.application_limits: On Gamma1 their weight 2 correction is a scalar group homomorphism, so commutator containment and power/root arguments use an abelian target. Our weight 4 correction is an actual Sym2-valued crossed homomorphism with nontrivial slash, and these assertions cannot be transferred without new proof. The paper does not classify our D12 origin stabilizer or prove a new odd-L irrationality statement.

new_local_result: research/cdt_odd_level12_stabilizer_structure_20261006.md proves a concrete free-factor decomposition from the complete frozen Schreier presentation and a sign-restricted all-word strict-cone exclusion. This theorem is proved locally, not inferred from either archived paper.
unresolved: Mixed-sign normal-form cancellations and the entire actual pureL/joint origin stabilizer remain open. Neither literature source closes this gap.
